d: A major cyber fraud racket has been busted in Noida, where 164 foreign nationals were allegedly held captive inside a paying guest (PG) accommodation. According to reports, their passports were confiscated, restricting their freedom of movement. The case has exposed a shocking network allegedly involving cyber fraud operations and the exploitation of foreign nationals. Authorities are investigating how these individuals were brought to India, who was operating the racket, and how the illegal activities were being carried out.
